111 | Recurring numbers | 30-minute breathing meditation
Biovagal: sound, breath and stillness.

WHAT YOU ARE SEEING: The number 111 on screen with your breathing circle. Breathe with the circle: in through the nose, out through the mouth, 5 seconds each way, or whichever feels comfortable. A short line appears every 10 seconds.
WHAT IT IS FOR: 30 minutes of slow breathing with one simple number to focus on, so you do not have to count or think.
WHO IT IS FOR: anyone who keeps noticing 111 or repeating numbers, people curious about numerology, and anyone who settles better with one thing to look at. Do you keep seeing 111? Tell me where in the comments.

Seeing the same number again and again is a very common experience. The usual explanation is that we notice patterns, and once we notice one we see it more. In traditional numerology 111 is associated with new beginnings. That is traditional symbolism, not science, and this video makes no claims about luck, messages, relationships, health or effects.
Intention: begin with one slow breath.
Breathe slowly and comfortably. Never hold your breath or breathe fast. If anything feels uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.
Headphones required (a soft binaural tone: Theta binaural beats, 6 Hz). The tone is synthesised, not a recording. No hidden audio. Visible text only.

Traditional associations and personal intentions. For relaxation only. Not medical advice. Do not use while driving.
Suggested practice: 30 minutes a day for 3 weeks.
